vb_textbox.text: At any given time, either the pink/purple gnomes or the grey/brown gnomes will yield the best number of mushrooms. For me, the game started with the grey/ brown gnomes giving the most. You'll need to play a few rounds to find out which pair is giving you the most. This will continue for a while, but when you start to get a handful of rounds below 1/2 mushrooms, it's probably time to swap. Keep your fingers on the keys, you can't pause so make sure you're ready before you start. I got a score of 1000+ with this advice... good luck!
